summary: Two women in their early 20s (one from Idaho, one from Utah) became cliffed out descending the Telluride via ferrata after starting the technical route around 6:30pm; responders first tried to guide them down remotely, then a SAR team deployed, set a short rappel and escorted the pair back to the trail. Neither was injured. Mission lasted more than four hours with roughly six SAR personnel.
location: Telluride via ferrata, east end of Telluride box canyon
responding_agency: San Miguel County Search and Rescue
notes: Run 203: June 13, 2026 was a Saturday; call came in ~9:55pm per report; corroborated by Denver Post version (stranded ~9:55pm Sat, ~4-hr mission, women from Utah and Idaho, ill-equipped for technical route).
